language.title: Language
language.scope: The default is your system language. Changes apply immediately to every DeliDev window.
language.notSaved: Language is not saved. Inspect the saved selection before trying again.
language.unavailable: Language storage is unavailable. Open the desktop app and check this computer’s configuration access.
language.readFailed: The saved language could not be read. The last known language remains active. Check configuration access, then reload language.
language.invalidDocument: The saved language is invalid. System is the fallback. The original file is preserved; repair or remove it before reloading language.
language.unsupportedVersion: The saved language uses an unsupported version. System is the fallback. The original file is preserved; use a compatible app or repair it before reloading language.
language.writeFailed: The language could not be saved. The last committed selection remains active. Check configuration access, then reload language before trying again.
language.outcomeUnknown: The save outcome is unknown. Reload language to inspect the committed selection before trying again.
language.changed: Language changed elsewhere. Reload language before choosing again.
language.widgetFailed: The language was saved, but widget language could not be synchronized. Reload language to try widget synchronization again.
